select s.esd_id as scheduleId, s.esd_position_id as positionId, pos.pos_title as positionTitle, s.esd_paper_id as paperId, p.epa_name as paperName, p.epa_duration_min as durationMin, p.epa_total_score as totalScore, date_format(s.esd_start_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as startAt, date_format(s.esd_end_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as endAt, s.esd_status as status, s.esd_max_attempts as maxAttempts, r.erc_id as recordId, r.erc_status as recordStatus, date_format(r.erc_start_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as recordStartAt, date_format(r.erc_submit_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as recordSubmitAt, r.erc_total_score as totalScoreGot, r.erc_pass_status as passStatus from t_exam_schedule s join t_exam_paper p on p.epa_id = s.esd_paper_id join t_pos pos on pos.pos_id = s.esd_position_id join t_tal t on t.tal_user_id = #{userId} join t_app_record a on a.app_position_id = s.esd_position_id and a.app_candidate_id = t.tal_id left join t_exam_record r on r.erc_schedule_id = s.esd_id and r.erc_candidate_id = t.tal_id order by s.esd_start_at desc, s.esd_id desc

select s.esd_id as scheduleId, s.esd_position_id as positionId, pos.pos_title as positionTitle, s.esd_paper_id as paperId, p.epa_name as paperName, p.epa_duration_min as durationMin, p.epa_total_score as totalScore, p.epa_rule_json as ruleJson, date_format(s.esd_start_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as startAt, date_format(s.esd_end_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as endAt, s.esd_status as status, s.esd_max_attempts as maxAttempts, s.esd_pass_threshold as passThreshold, s.esd_force_dual_camera as forceDualCamera, s.esd_submit_rule_json as submitRule, r.erc_id as recordId, r.erc_status as recordStatus, date_format(r.erc_start_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as recordStartAt from t_exam_schedule s join t_exam_paper p on p.epa_id = s.esd_paper_id join t_pos pos on pos.pos_id = s.esd_position_id join t_tal t on t.tal_user_id = #{userId} join t_app_record a on a.app_position_id = s.esd_position_id and a.app_candidate_id = t.tal_id left join t_exam_record r on r.erc_schedule_id = s.esd_id and r.erc_candidate_id = t.tal_id where s.esd_id = #{scheduleId}
mapper.insert: insert into t_exam_record (erc_schedule_id, erc_candidate_id, erc_start_at, erc_status, erc_main_device_info) values (#{scheduleId}, #{talId}, now(), 1, #{deviceInfo})
mapper.select: select r.erc_id as recordId, r.erc_schedule_id as scheduleId, r.erc_candidate_id as talId, r.erc_status as status, date_format(r.erc_start_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as startAt, date_format(r.erc_submit_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as submitAt, s.esd_paper_id as paperId, s.esd_position_id as positionId, pos.pos_title as positionTitle, p.epa_name as paperName, p.epa_duration_min as durationMin, p.epa_total_score as totalScore, r.erc_total_score as earnedScore, r.erc_pass_status as passStatus, date_format(s.esd_end_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as endAt, s.esd_submit_rule_json as submitRule, s.esd_status as scheduleStatus from t_exam_record r join t_exam_schedule s on s.esd_id = r.erc_schedule_id join t_exam_paper p on p.epa_id = s.esd_paper_id join t_pos pos on pos.pos_id = s.esd_position_id join t_tal t on t.tal_id = r.erc_candidate_id and t.tal_user_id = #{userId} where r.erc_id = #{recordId}
mapper.insert: insert ignore into t_exam_answer (ean_record_id, ean_question_id, ean_max_score) values (#{recordId}, #{questionId}, #{maxScore})
mapper.select: select a.ean_question_id as questionId, a.ean_content as answer, a.ean_max_score as score, q.eqs_type as type, q.eqs_content as content, q.eqs_options_json as optionsJson from t_exam_answer a join t_exam_question q on q.eqs_id = a.ean_question_id where a.ean_record_id = #{recordId} order by a.ean_id
mapper.update: update t_exam_record set erc_status = 2, erc_submit_at = now(), erc_updated_at = now() where erc_id = #{recordId} and erc_status = 1
update t_exam_record set erc_status = 3, erc_updated_at = now() where erc_id = #{recordId} and erc_status = 1
